findings.statement: CA9 is up-regulated in tumour at RNA (log2FC 6.312) and protein (log2FC 2.269), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and persists at purity 1 (7.787), so it is tumour-cell intrinsic; girentuximab reached PHASE_3. It is not prognostic (Cox log HR -0.009).

SCARB1 ranks first in the target profile: RNA log2FC 2.974, protein log2FC 1.837, TCGA log2FC 3.989 and a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 3.762 (SE 0.408), indicating tumour-intrinsic overexpression. It has no ccRCC dependency signal (DepMap mean effect 0.002) and no drugs.

CD70 is up-regulated at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 7.09) and keeps a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 4.278. It is a membrane ligand with clinical-stage antibodies (cusatuzumab PHASE_2, vorsetuzumab mafodotin PHASE_1).

ENPP3 is up at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 5.557) and has a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 5.278. It has a 18.2% copy-number loss rate (cnv_loss_freq 0.182) and an ADC (AGS-16C3F, PHASE_2).

SLC16A3 (a lactate transporter) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 3.291) with a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 3.821, and shows a positive cis copy-number effect (rho 0.258). It is undrugged and not prognostic at BH<0.05 (Cox padj 0.0887).

NNMT is strongly up at RNA (log2FC 4.67) and protein (log2FC 2.709), replicates in TCGA (log2FC 4.685) and high expression is associated with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479), giving the top biomarker-profile score among up-regulated genes. DepMap mean effect in ccRCC is 0.316, so a dependency is not supported.

FABP6 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.006) and protein (log2FC 1.921) and replicates in TCGA (log2FC 6.431). It shows frequent copy-number gain (cnv_gain_freq 0.573) with a positive cis effect (rho 0.309), so gain is a plausible dosage driver.

PSAT1 is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963), replicates in TCGA (log2FC -2.974) and low expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR 0.43, padj 5.66e-7). It is the top biomarker-profile gene.

ALDH6A1, a loss-of-tubule-identity marker, is down at RNA (log2FC -3.399) and protein (log2FC -1.925), with 0.355 copy-number loss frequency and a strong positive cis effect (rho 0.525). Low expression is associated with worse survival (Cox log HR -0.554, padj 9.45e-12), but the purity-1 RNA log2FC shrinks to -1.973.

VWF is up at RNA (log2FC 3.605) and protein (log2FC 1.284) and is associated with better survival (Cox log HR -0.397, padj 1.97e-7). It is an endothelial/vascular signal and its tumour-cell origin is less certain (purity-1 RNA log2FC 3.521), making it a biomarker rather than a tumour-cell target despite approved vWF-directed drugs.

L1CAM is down in tumour at RNA (log2FC -2.623) and protein (log2FC -1.714), replicates in TCGA (log2FC -5.785) and low expression is associated with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.328, padj 0.00000567); its loss is a biomarker, not a target.

PCK1 is down at RNA (log2FC -4.424) and protein (log2FC -1.859), reflecting loss of proximal-tubule gluconeogenic identity, replicates in TCGA (log2FC -3.079) and is associated with worse survival when low (Cox log HR -0.415, padj 1.91e-7).
VHL is somatically mutated in 247 of 511 ccRCC tumours (frequency 0.483, padj 0.0), the dominant driver behind the HIF-driven up-regulation of CA9, ANGPTL4 and related genes.
PBRM1 is mutated in 185 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.362, padj 4.59e-239) and lies on 3p with a copy-number loss frequency of 0.8 in CPTAC, consistent with the two-hit 3p loss plus mutation mechanism.

caveats: Dependency (DepMap) evidence is weak for the top up-regulated genes (mean ccRCC effects near zero or positive except SCD, -0.501), so target claims rest on expression, replication and tractability, not essentiality.
Bulk tumour comparisons can include stromal/endothelial contributions (e.g. VWF); purity-1 extrapolations have wide SEs.
Protein log2FC values are TMT ratios and are compressed relative to RNA log2FC.
Safety in normal tissue was not assessed by the omics layers; prognosis is from univariate Cox in TCGA-KIRC only.
Not all ranked genes had individual calls to rna_protein_correlation; values come from the convergence ranking rows and per-gene DE queries.
